response.justification: Bogdan is a skilled, experienced software engineer but fundamentally misaligned with this C++ industrial-automation role. His C++ experience is minimal and outdated (6 months in 2014-2015). More critically, his 20-year career has progressively moved away from systems programming toward web and backend development, leaving no industrial automation, IoT, embedded systems, or industrial protocol experience. The role's core emphasis on security practices (IEC 62443, SDL) is entirely absent from his profile.
strengths: 20+ years of proven software development with demonstrated expertise in high-performance distributed systems handling millions of requests per second
Strong understanding of event-driven architectures and asynchronous I/O patterns from Dunnhumby and GISCollective work
Excellent mentorship and technical communication demonstrated through workshops, open-source leadership, and community initiatives
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (6 months in 2014-2015); role requires 8-12 years of active hands-on C++ and STL expertise
Complete lack of industrial automation, IoT, embedded systems, and industrial protocol background; career entirely focused on web and backend development
No evidence of security practices, secure development lifecycle, or IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards knowledge which the role emphasizes as core responsibility
